text: `parent.AddCommand(children...)` sets each child's private `parent` field to the receiving command, updates maximum display lengths, propagates any global normalization function, appends the child to `c.commands`, and marks sorting stale. It panics if a command is added as its own child (`command.go:1302-1330`). `Parent()` returns the stored pointer (`command.go:1842-1845`).
